QUIC ACK queue and frame generation tests.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for the QUIC ACK generation code. It checks `fd_quic_ack_gen_init`, `fd_quic_ack_pkt`, and `fd_quic_gen_ack_frames` by inserting packet numbers, merging ranges, handling gaps, handling encryption level changes, and testing queue overflow. It also decodes generated ACK frames with `fd_quic_decode_ack_frame` and verifies the frame fields and buffer length results. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs the tests, prints `pass` on success, and then stops the runtime with `fd_halt()`.
